teach.what_it_is: A placeholder cover sheet used only in OpenSeason tests. It is not a New Jersey court form.
teach.when_used: When an automated test installs the NJ appeal fixture pack.
common_mistakes: Treating this file as something you can file.
Using example.test URLs as if they were the court.
teach.learn_more: Install a real state pack when Josh hosts one. Confirm every form on the court's own site.

situations.label: I need to appeal a decision
situations.question: Did a trial court enter a final order you want a higher court to review?
situations.court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division
situations.why: The fixture pack only has a fake cover sheet. A real notice-of-appeal deadline is not in this fixture; do not invent one.

steps.title: Read the court's own appeal kit
steps.why: The fixture file is not the official kit.

teach.what_it_is: A reminder to use the official New Jersey pro se appellate materials, not this fixture.
teach.when_used: After a final trial-court order, if you are considering an appeal.
common_mistakes: Missing the notice-of-appeal deadline. Confirm the current rule; this fixture does not state a day count.
teach.learn_more: JustLegal lists CN 10837 as the NJ pro se appellate kit. Confirm on njcourts.gov.
